findings.title: Priority 7a names IRB08 as the only cleanup successor but widening-abort requires IR13C
findings.requirement: Rollback cleanup ownership must be single and deterministic for every origin and cancellation coordinate.
evidence: §15.1 priority 7a says ROLLED_BACK plus NOT_REQUIRED projects to ROLLED_BACK and `only IRB08 may schedule cleanup next`.
§15.3.1 forbids IRB08 for WIDENING_ABORT under cancellation NONE and names IR13A then IR13C as the sole cleanup path.
§15.8 repeats that widening-abort uses IR13C under NONE while promotion uses IRB08.
findings.impact: A literal checker cannot satisfy both normative instructions. It either rejects required widening-abort cleanup or admits forbidden IRB08.
findings.required_correction: Qualify priority 7a by rollback origin: IRB08 is sole for non-WIDENING_ABORT; WIDENING_ABORT stays ROLLED_BACK through IR12/IR13A and uses IR13C only. Add this partition to checker assertions.

findings.title: IH01-W/P start rollback without an exact atomic disposition of the live mutation Effect
findings.requirement: Degradation must fence sends, expose no hidden live activity, and prevent rollback from racing a still-applying original effect.
evidence: IH01-W changes WIDENING_EFFECT->CANARY_ABORTING and rollback IDLE->REQUESTED, but only says `stop/reconcile effect`; no Effect source, target, or synchronized E-row is named.
IH01-P likewise changes PROMOTING->FAILED and rollback IDLE->REQUESTED with only `stop/reconcile effect`.
§15 applies only named coordinate changes, while IRB01 permits rollback dispatch without requiring the original Effect terminal, quarantined, or proved unable to apply.
findings.impact: Rollback can dispatch while the external mutation is SENDING, UNKNOWN, or LIVE; delayed application after restoration can defeat rollback and the no-hidden-activity invariant.
findings.required_correction: Partition IH01-W/P by exact reachable Effect state and name a synchronized Effect transition or durable stop/no-send receipt. Gate IRB01 until application is impossible or reconciliation/isolation supplies safe ordering. Generate degradation-versus-send/response races.

findings.title: Terminal Effect products require impossible exposure variants for conclusive pre-dispatch failures
findings.requirement: Reachable edge/product equality and exposure classification must be internally consistent.
evidence: E30 is INTENT_RECORDED->FAILED_FINAL with signed no-send; E31 is READY_TO_SEND->FAILED_FINAL before dispatch; E35 is RETRY_AUTHORIZED->FAILED_FINAL before dispatch after absence proof.
IWD30X/IPD30X, IWD31X/IPD31X, and IWD35X/IPD35X nevertheless require ExposureReceipt proving application/exposure.
§15.8 demands the listed direct edges be crossed by X/N classification and reachable-edge/product-row set equality; N variants correctly require no send/application or absence.
findings.impact: The X guards contradict the same effect's no-send/absence facts. The promised reachable product equality is not reproducible, and ExposureReceipt scope is ambiguous.
findings.required_correction: Make classification target-effect-specific. Remove unreachable X variants for no-dispatch edges, or define equality over a constrained reachable relation rather than a Cartesian family. Reject an ExposureReceipt conflicting with the edge receipt.
